notes_summary: Large-scale RAG migration: embeddings + cross-encoder reranker; evals-driven POC with A/B + canary; primary concerns: ranking regressions and data residency
notes: Company background: enterprise legal research SaaS, heavy long-doc search (court opinions, contracts). Current vector store + in-house reranker; looking to replace embedder + reranker to reduce cost + improve recall.
Scale: ~45M unique documents (mixed lengths, avg 1.6k tokens per doc after chunking). Indexed at 3 shard regions. Ingest rate: ~200k docs/day during batch updates.
Traffic & perf targets: production peak ~350 QPS (search+rerank); target p95 end-to-end latency <= 250ms for query->topK reranked result (goal), p99 <= 500ms acceptable for premium customers.
Cost goals: reduce unit cost per query (search+rerank) to <$0.02 on average; current cost estimated ~$0.035/query.

Models under consideration: open-embed-1024 (candidate), redwood-embed-v2 (recommended by internal team), text-embedding-3-large (baseline). Reranker candidates: lightweight cross-encoder (distil-cross), redwood-rerank-small, a distilled cross-encoder from vendor X.
Quality constraints: cannot accept >2% NDCG@10 drop vs current baseline on our 5k eval queries; regression thresholds must be codified in evals alerts and gated in rollout.

Eval approach: holdout testset (10k labeled Qs), human labeling panel for edge cases, automated evals harness (we want Redwood's Optimize integration + our custom metrics), A/B + canary rollouts with traffic split and rollback triggers.
Architecture preferences: prefer running inference on Dedicated VMs (reserved GPU pools) for predictable latency; private control plane due to client confidentiality; KMS integration mandatory.
Security & compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs for every model call (retention 12 months), explicit data residency for EU clients.

PoC plan (high level):
- Week 0: infra + dataset handoff. Create sample index (5M docs) and match shard topology.
- Week 1: run candidate embedder on sample index; measure recall/embedding latency and index size. A/B vs baseline (approx 50/50 traffic synthetic).
- Week 2: deploy candidate reranker as canary, evaluate end-to-end ranking on 10k eval queries with human labels. Track NDCG, MRR, precision@k, latency.
- Week 3: scale to 20M sample; stress test at 350 QPS; run cost simulation via Redwood Optimize.
- Week 4: compile evals report; decision gate - proceed to phased rollout or rollback.
Risk notes / blockers (details):

- "Quality/regression" is the primary blocker: product team will not accept any non-trivial drop in user-observed relevance (legal domain is high precision). Need rigorous eval thresholds and human review workflow.
- Data residency nuance: EU clients cannot have embeddings stored outside EU region; need region pinning + audit log proof.
- Integration: existing ingestion pipeline uses custom chunker and metadata tagging; need compatibility test with Redwood's tokenizer/embedding chunk alignments.
